seasons.gameBreakdown: In the 2026 FRC Season, Reefscape, two alliances of 3 teams each compete to score a lot of fuel (Dense foam balls, unlike the wiffle balls from 2017) into a giant structure known as the hub. Each team has 1 Minute and 50 Seconds to score fuel, including the 20 seconds of autonomous operation, the 10-second transition shift, and the 50 seconds per alliance shift, during which the opposing alliance won't earn points, followed by the last 30 seconds. There is also a tower to climb, where, if you climb it autonomously, you can earn a total of 30 points via 2 robots at level 1, making it a lot easier to earn that ranking point. Whichever alliance and the end of the game wins the match.
seasons.robotInfo: Drivetrain: Similar to the last 3 years, we used a Swerve Drivetrain, using MK5n modules from Swerve Drive Specialties. Although at first Saturn used a standard indexer, we switched it out for a spindexer at Mason due to slight issues with using a spindexer, we used a turret both times to allow us to be able to angle shots to be more precise.
seasons.seasonReflection: We believe that even though we didn't make it to States again, we did quite well this season. We managed to be more student-lead than the prior season, and we won an award, unlike last season.
